problem: Powerhouse Skill Projection canonicalization failed before evaluating learning semantics because historical replay imported parse5 while the workflow had not installed repository dependencies.
root_cause: The skill-projection workflow ran setup-node and immediately executed learning-canonicalization-gate.mjs. Classified historical replay tests can import repository modules with package dependencies, so a clean runner failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before the replay assertion could run.
prevention: Install repository dependencies before executing canonicalization or classified historical replay tests.
Classify missing package/module during replay bootstrap as a workflow bootstrap defect, not as evidence that the learning is invalid.
Keep replay fail-closed and repair its execution environment instead of weakening or deleting regression evidence.
Guard dependency bootstrap ordering with an executable Brain regression.

evidence.symptom: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: parse5 before historical replay assertion
